content: You can now install roc through homebrew with brew install roc-lang/roc/roc. Can you all give it a try before I put it in announcements?
I can confirm it works on Windows 11 WSL. I'm going to try later today on my Linux machines.
It worked fine on my MacBook (Apple silicon), I got the 2026-10-09 nightly. The uninstall process worked fine too.
